items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: But now, I'll show you one band that you found that came from New York, and they really didn't make it 'cause they didn't do enough playing ad-lib. And that was Harlan Leonard. His band was too much arrangement.

ctx.x: They quoted him as saying that. But they also -- Leonard then it also quoted Bird as saying that nobody in the McShann band could play but him. And --
